title: Heavy rainfall ongoing in Central and Western Liberia (Nov 20, 2025)
summary: Heavy rainfall is currently on going in Central and Western Liberia. The rain is expected to persist for the next two hours. This will lead to localized flooding in low-lying areas, reduced visibility on major roads, drainage systems becoming flooded, slick and slippery road surfaces.

title: Flash Flood Hate Montserrado County
summary: Continuous heavy downpours of rain since 3:00 AM have caused flash flooding across parts of Montserrado County. Low-lying areas, drainage channels, and informal settlements are experiencing significant water accumulation. Reports indicate localized property damage and road disruptions, making some areas difficult to access.
region: Montserrado / Greater Monrovia and its environs
